item.title: IMG_0938.jpg - Score 47.3/100
item.description:
Genre: product. Score: 47.3/100.
After editing: 87.0/100 (+39.7).
Improvements: Replace/remove the checkerboard transparency background and set a clean solid background (white or a deliberate brand color); alternatively export as true PNG with transparency preserved for placement; Increase separation between the camera silhouette and background by deepening blacks with a gentle curve and setting black point (e.g., Blacks -15 to -30; add a mild S-curve); Refine edges and remove jaggies/aliasing: upscale 2x with high-quality resampling, apply slight Gaussian blur (0.3–0.6px) then threshold/levels to re-crisp, or use vectorization/pen tool cleanup where needed; Crop and straighten for balanced composition, centering the camera and reducing excess empty space while keeping consistent margins; Replace transparent checkered background with solid white or neutral gray background.

item.title: IMG_2274 Large.jpeg - Score 76.0/100
item.description:
Genre: architecture. Score: 76.0/100.
After editing: 78.7/100 (+2.7).
Improvements: Recover highlight detail in the brightest brick areas using Highlights (-25 to -45) and a slight Whites reduction (-5 to -15), while protecting the window glow with a selective mask if needed; Lift deep shadows slightly (Shadows +10 to +25) and set black point carefully (Blacks -5 to -15) to maintain contrast; consider a subtle curve to keep midtone punch; Cool the overall color temperature slightly (Temp -300 to -700K) and reduce orange saturation in HSL (Orange Sat -5 to -15) while preserving warm sun directionality; Apply perspective/transform correction: reduce vertical convergence slightly and ensure the main wall edge feels intentional; crop a bit from the right to minimize the heavy black mass if it’s not a deliberate framing element; Add targeted micro-contrast on the brick (Texture +10 to +20, Clarity +5 to +10) with a mask limited to the lit wall; avoid boosting the sky/shadows.
